run_livejournal_example: run the livejournal example to download data, train a graph embedding model, and evaluate it
run_train_and_eval: run the torchbiggraph training and evaluation pipeline on the LiveJournal social network dataset
run_random_split_file: run the random_split_file function to shuffle and split an edge list into train and test files
run_convert_input_data: run convert_input_data with a TSVEdgelistReader to transform raw edge list files into torchbiggraph format
run_download_and_extract: run the download and gzip extraction of the LiveJournal dataset from the SNAP Stanford URL
